## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-dto.06c54672"></a>**1. The unit backend/src/auth/dto contains two TypeScript files — auth-response.dto.ts and ip-blocking.dto.ts — which together declare eight exported DTO classes.**
  [`auth-response.dto.ts:1-36`](../auth-response.dto.ts#L1-L36)
  [`ip-blocking.dto.ts:1-79`](../ip-blocking.dto.ts#L1-L79)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-dto.72901a78"></a>**2. backend/src/auth/auth.controller.ts imports from both files in the unit: AuthStatusDto and LogoutResponseDto from auth-response.dto.js, and UnblockIpDto, UnblockResponseDto, and IpStatusDto from ip-blocking.dto.js.**
  [`auth.controller.ts:26-34`](../../auth.controller.ts#L26-L34)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-dto.9f057329"></a>**3. auth-response.dto.ts declares the exported class UserDto with four required string properties — email, firstName, lastName, and picture — each annotated with an @ApiProperty decorator from @nestjs/swagger.**
  [`auth-response.dto.ts:3-15`](../auth-response.dto.ts#L3-L15)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-dto.3360858c"></a>**4. auth-response.dto.ts declares the exported class AuthStatusDto with a required boolean property authenticated and an optional UserDto property user annotated with @ApiPropertyOptional.**
  [`auth-response.dto.ts:17-23`](../auth-response.dto.ts#L17-L23)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-dto.8678031f"></a>**5. ip-blocking.dto.ts declares the exported class UnblockIpDto with a required string property ip validated by the class-validator @IsIP decorator.**
  [`ip-blocking.dto.ts:4-11`](../ip-blocking.dto.ts#L4-L11)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-dto.be3a6715"></a>**6. auth-response.dto.ts declares the exported class AuthResponseDto with a required string property message and a required UserDto property user.**
  [`auth-response.dto.ts:25-31`](../auth-response.dto.ts#L25-L31)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-dto.5c028e22"></a>**7. auth-response.dto.ts declares the exported class LogoutResponseDto with a single required string property message.**
  [`auth-response.dto.ts:33-36`](../auth-response.dto.ts#L33-L36)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-dto.bdfad290"></a>**8. ip-blocking.dto.ts declares the exported class BlockedIpInfoDto with five required properties — ip (string), attempts (number), blockedAt (number), reason (string), and timeRemaining (number) — each annotated with an @ApiProperty decorator.**
  [`ip-blocking.dto.ts:13-43`](../ip-blocking.dto.ts#L13-L43)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-dto.3e8353c6"></a>**9. ip-blocking.dto.ts declares the exported class UnblockResponseDto with two required string properties — message and ip.**
  [`ip-blocking.dto.ts:45-57`](../ip-blocking.dto.ts#L45-L57)
- <a id="research.backend-src-auth-dto.b892d58a"></a>**10. ip-blocking.dto.ts declares the exported class IpStatusDto with a required boolean property blocked and two optional properties — failedAttempts (number) and blockInfo (BlockedIpInfoDto).**
  [`ip-blocking.dto.ts:59-79`](../ip-blocking.dto.ts#L59-L79)
